goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: On Day 1, new hires have a 09:00 welcome meeting with their manager, 09:30 IT setup, 10:30 HR onboarding session, 12:00 welcome lunch, 13:30 self-guided online modules, 15:00 buddy introductory call, and 16:00 free time to explore the intranet and team documentation.

story: A new hire asks what their first day orientation schedule looks like.
starting_sentence: What happens on my first day of orientation?
